title: Aspire Flexus Q Pod Kit
description: Aspire Flexus Q Pod Kit Inspired by the simplicity and versatility of refillable pod kits and the discreet portability of disposables, the new Flexus Q pod kit from Aspire is a compact, lightweight and elegant pod kit that’s ideal for new vapers and experienced vapers alike. The Flexus Q features a 700mAh built-in battery which is charged in no time thanks to a Type-C USB charge port, reaching up to an 80% charge in 10 minutes. Aspire’s ASP chipset supports an array of safety protections and allows for three different wattage levels: soft, normal, and hard, and it can automatically detect the coil resistance and select the optimum wattage to deliver the best vaping experience. The kit can be operated via autodraw – simply take a puff as you would a traditional cigarette – or via the fire button. A sliding airflow control lets you tailor the intensity of every puff from a tight MTL (mouth-to-lung) vape to a richer RDL (restricted direct lung) vape. The refillable pods can be topped up with the side-fill port, and features a super-comfortable mouthpiece. The Flexus Q pods use the all new AF(Aspire Flexus) 0.6Ω & 1.0Ω vertical mesh coil, which heats more evenly to fully atomize the e-liquid, effectively enhancing both flavour and nicotine delivery. The Flexus Q is a low-powered device that’s perfect for use with Nic Salt , 50/50 and classic High-PG E-Liquids.
